comments.zh: 多层 PostMap 洋葱模型：注册 2 个 PostMap，验证执行顺序（先注册后执行）。
comments.en: Multi-layer PostMap onion model: registers two PostMaps and verifies execution order (registration order is reverse of execution order).

comments.en: Inner layer: registered first, executed last (closest to the mapping core).

comments.zh: Outer layer: registered last, executed first (wraps the inner one)
comments.en: Outer layer: registered last, executed first (wrapping the inner layer).
